units.text: 4. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the highest group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of Active State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 8

units.text: 5. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the principal group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 8

units.text: 6. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the leading group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 8

units.text: 7. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the senior group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 8

units.text: 8. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the junior group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 8

units.text: 9. The civil service class ranks of Active State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 8

units.text: 10. In the Staff Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow and in the executive authorities of the City of Moscow, the civil service class ranks of State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the Mayor of Moscow. In other state bodies, the civil service class ranks of State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 8

units.text: 11. The civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, and State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 8

units.text: 12. Civil servants entering the civil service for the first time are conferred the minimum class ranks for the respective groups of civil service positions to which their positions belong. These class ranks are conferred after successful completion of probation or, if no probation was set, upon expiry of three months after appointment to a civil service position, except in the cases provided for in part 12.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 8

units.text: 12.1. A citizen holding a class rank of a municipal servant of an intracity municipal formation in the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as a municipal servant) who enters the civil service is conferred a civil service class rank, from the date of appointment to a civil service position, in accordance with the table of correspondence between municipal servants’ class ranks and civil service class ranks:
units.label: Part 12.1 Art. 8

units.text: Active Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st class; Active Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class; Active Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class; Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st class | State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Active Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st class;…”

units.text: Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class | State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class | State…”

units.text: Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class | State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class | State…”

units.text: Municipal Service Councillor in the City of Moscow, 1st class | State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Councillor in the City of Moscow, 1st class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Councillor in the City of Moscow, 2nd class | State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Councillor in the City of Moscow, 2nd class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Councillor in the City of Moscow, 3rd class | State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Councillor in the City of Moscow, 3rd class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Referent in the City of Moscow, 1st class | State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 1st class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Referent in the City of Moscow, 1st class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Referent in the City of Moscow, 2nd class | State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 2nd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Referent in the City of Moscow, 2nd class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Referent in the City of Moscow, 3rd class | State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 3rd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Referent in the City of Moscow, 3rd class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Secretary in the City of Moscow, 1st class | State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 1st class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Secretary in the City of Moscow, 1st class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Secretary in the City of Moscow, 2nd class | State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 2nd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Secretary in the City of Moscow, 2nd class |…”

units.text: Municipal Service Secretary in the City of Moscow, 3rd class | State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 3rd class
units.label: Art. 8 · “Municipal Service Secretary in the City of Moscow, 3rd class |…”

units.text: 13. Entries on the conferral of class ranks are made in civil servants’ personnel files and employment record books (where available).
units.label: Part 13 Art. 8

units.text: 14. From the date on which class ranks are conferred, civil servants are paid monthly rank salaries corresponding to the civil service class ranks conferred on them.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 8

units.text: 15. Successive class ranks are conferred on civil servants within the respective groups of civil service positions to which their positions belong, subject to expiry of the period established for service in the previous class rank:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 8

units.text: 1) in the class ranks of State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class, or State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class — at least one year;
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 8

units.text: 2) in the class ranks of State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class, or State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class — at least two years.
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 8

units.text: 16. No minimum periods in the class ranks of Active State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class, are established for conferral of the next class rank.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 8

units.text: 17. When civil servants are appointed to civil service positions belonging to higher groups than the positions they previously held, they are conferred the minimum class ranks for the respective groups of civil service positions to which their new positions belong, without observing the sequence of ranks and without taking account of time spent in the previous class rank. These class ranks are conferred after successful completion of probation or, if no probation was set, upon expiry of three months after appointment to a civil service position.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 8

units.text: 18. For special distinction in the civil service, on the recommendation of the immediate supervisor, a civil servant may be conferred a further class rank:
units.label: Part 18 Art. 8

units.text: 1) before expiry of the period established by part 15 of this Article, but no earlier than six months after taking up the civil service position held;
units.label: Point 1 Part 18 Art. 8

units.text: 2) upon expiry of the period established by part 15 of this Article, one rank above the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held, within the group of civil service positions to which that position belongs.
units.label: Point 2 Part 18 Art. 8

units.text: 19. Civil servants retain the class ranks conferred on them upon release from their civil service positions and dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 8

units.text: 20. Civil servants may be deprived of the class ranks conferred on them on the grounds and in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 8

units.text: 21. A further class rank may not be conferred on civil servants suspended from their civil service positions in accordance with Article 29 of this Law.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 8

units.text: 22. A civil servant who has a disciplinary sanction that has not been lifted in accordance with the established procedure shall not be conferred a further class rank.
units.label: Part 22 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.label: Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 1. Filling a civil service position requires compliance with qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education and professional level and, where the employer’s representative has made a corresponding decision, the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained upon completion of an additional professional retraining programme.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 2. Qualification requirements for civil service positions are established in accordance with the categories and groups of civil service positions and the field and type of a civil servant's professional service activity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 3. Holding positions in the ‘managers’, ‘assistants (advisers)’ and ‘specialists’ categories of the highest and principal groups of civil service positions requires higher education at no less than specialist degree or master's degree level.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 4. Higher education is mandatory for positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories of the leading group, the ‘specialists’ category of the leading and senior groups, and the ‘support specialists’ category of the principal and leading groups of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 4.1. Professional education is mandatory for positions in the ‘support specialists’ category of the senior and junior groups of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 5. No qualification requirements concerning length of civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training apply to the filling of civil service positions.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 6. This part was repealed with effect from 17 October 2009 by Law of the City of Moscow of 16 September 2009 No. 34.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 7. Qualification requirements concerning professional level are established by a civil servant's official duties regulations according to the category and group of the civil service position and the field and type of professional service activity. A civil servant's official duties regulations (hereinafter official duties regulations) may also prescribe qualification requirements concerning the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained through an additional professional retraining programme necessary to hold the civil service position.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 8. Unless otherwise established by federal law, compliance by a citizen applying for a civil service position or by a civil servant with the qualification requirements for that position is checked by the state body’s structural subdivision responsible for state service and personnel matters (hereinafter also referred to as the state body’s personnel service).
units.label: Part 8 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
units.text: 9. To check whether a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant meets the qualification requirements concerning professional level, the state body's personnel service assesses that citizen's or civil servant's professional level for the position. The assessment uses methods not contrary to federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, with the participation of the state body's subdivision in which the position is established. By decision of the head of the state body or a person authorized by that head, scientific, educational and other organizations specializing in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activity or in personnel technologies and civil service matters, and their representatives, may be involved in the assessment.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 9

units.locator: Chapter 3. Legal position (status) of a civil servant
units.text: Chapter 3. Legal position (status) of a civil servant
units.label: Chapter 3. Legal position (status) of a civil servant

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant has the right to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 1) provision of proper organizational and technical conditions necessary for performing official duties;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 2) familiarization with the official duties regulations and other regulatory legal acts defining their rights and duties in the civil service position held, the criteria for assessing the efficiency of their performance of official duties, the performance indicators of their professional service activities, and the conditions for career advancement;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 3) rest, ensured through normal service hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid basic and additional leave; 4) monetary remuneration and other payments connected with the performance of official duties in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, this Law, decrees of the Mayor of Moscow and the terms of the service contract;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 5) obtaining, in the prescribed manner, information and materials necessary for performing official duties;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 6) making proposals to improve the activities of the state body;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 7) access, in the prescribed manner, to information constituting state secrets if the performance of official duties involves the use of such information;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 8) access, in the prescribed manner in connection with the performance of official duties, to state bodies, local self-government bodies in the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as local self-government bodies), public associations and other organizations of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 9) access to appraisals of their professional service activity and other documents before inclusion in their personnel file, access to personnel file materials, and inclusion of their written explanations and other documents and materials in that file;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 10) protection of information about the civil servant;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 11) career advancement on a competitive basis;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 12) professional education in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, this Law and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 13) membership of a trade union; 14) consideration of individual service disputes in accordance with federal laws;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 15) an internal service inquiry at their request;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 16) protection of their rights and lawful interests in the civil service, including judicial challenge of violations;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 10
